reviews.text: Requesting a refund: the onboarding quiz funnel takes forever, then stops working and stops your progress. reviews.title: Unauthorized transactions on your account Will occur

As a result, my bank has locked my card several times for security reasons. This has caused significant inconvenience, leaving me stranded at ATMs and in grocery store checkout lines because my card was turned off due to this app's activity. I strongly advise against using this service. Wish I could leave a negative star review!

reviews.title: Falsely Advertised
reviews.text:
I had a very disappointing experience with this platform. It was advertised in a way that strongly suggested an AI-driven trading system, but after signing up, it turned out to be more of a basic skills and education platform. That’s a big difference, and it felt misleading right from the start.
When I raised this concern and requested a refund, the response I received was polite but ultimately unhelpful. They acknowledged my frustration but refused to issue a refund, instead offering more time on the platform and additional learning materials—neither of which addressed the core issue. If the service isn’t what was expected, extending access to it doesn’t solve the problem.
It feels like the focus is more on retention than accountability. Canceling future charges is the bare minimum, not a resolution. A company that stands behind its product should be willing to make things right when expectations are clearly not met.
Overall, I would advise others to be cautious and read the fine print carefully before signing up. What’s advertised and what you actually get may not align.

reviews.title: This is a scam and the posts that say it’s great are lies..
reviews.text:
I downloaded this app thinking I was risking maybe twenty bucks just to test it out. Instead, I got slammed with charges totaling over $140 for what turned out to be nothing more than a fake trading simulator pretending to be real investing.

You are NOT trading real money. You are NOT making real profits. It’s basically a glorified mock trading game designed to make people think they’re participating in actual live trading while the company keeps charging your card.

The advertising is misleading as hell and conveniently leaves out the fact that you cannot actually withdraw or keep the “profits” you supposedly make inside the app. That alone should raise massive red flags for anyone considering downloading this garbage.

This app feels like a bait-and-switch scam wrapped in flashy marketing and fake promises. Complete waste of money, complete waste of time, and absolutely not worth the outrageous charges they hit me with.

I am demanding a full refund immediately because this service was not honestly represented. People deserve to know exactly what they are paying for before getting trapped into these deceptive subscriptions and fake trading systems.

Avoid this app.

Which of course all they said they could do was give me four free weeks? Like what good does that do more useless training with no real trading platform! reviews.title: Beware of Subscription Renewal
reviews.text:
I was under the impression I’d canceled before the renewal date, but apparently I hadn’t. And even though I reached out same day it renewed, they refused to issue me a refund, and instead tried to offer me an ‘extension’. Oh, and it was 100% an AI bot that kept replying to my emails (and getting my name wrong, to boot). 

Edit: Just before writing this I said in an email I was going to leave a poor review about it. They just sent me an email offering me a 50% refund. 1) I know they can refund all of it, they’re just choosing not to, and 2) I shouldn’t have to threaten a bad review for good customer service. And for that I’m not changing my review.

reviews.title: Why 1 Star
reviews.text: This is an excellent educational tool. I gave it one star because of its obviously purposeful and misleading advertising. If it’s an educational tool, they should tell you it’s an educational tool only. They should have disclosures or let people know. They should not mislead people into thinking they can start with $20 and make money and do things like pay off your vehicle after 28 days.. They should tell people that this is for people who the capital to invest to begin with or already have a portfolio and want to learn how to better manage their investments themselves. People need to be aware that all this is doing is teaching you and helping you track stocks. There is no AI tool, no magic wand or no anything else that is going to let you take $20 and make money trading anything. Even with this tool, you will not make money trading stock without risk and without significant capital to invest or an existing stock portfolio. Their 28 day challenge is misleading BS. If you believe in your product, then be honest about your product. This company miss leads because they want people to pay the subscription fee and nothing else.

reviews.title: Does not actually trade for you…
reviews.text:
Update: received a developer response, and apparently the ads lead to misunderstandings. LIES. 
Not only is that a blatant lie (the ads clearly state that AI trades for you), the developers cannot even admit it. The ads sell blatant lies!

Stay away from this app if you use it thinking you’re going to pay $20 then have your account just grow overnight, because it’s based on lies.


Ads clearly say that AI does the reading for you. 

IT DOES NOT! This app is a guided course. 

So the ads are misleading (as usual), and just a ploy to get you spend the $20. In a time where money is tight for most ppl, the developers make it sound like “pay $20, AI will earn you money without doing anything”. So another lie. Impossible to business with a company who makes sound effortless and yet it’s not. 

So if classes in stuff is not your thing this will be a waste of time and money. Do you, but don’t go in expecting to get rich by doing nothing, as the ads suggest. 

It should be illegal to make ads like that, as it’s practically just stealing.

reviews.title: Abysmal customer service

When you get the product, including the extra add-ons they push upon you, you find out it is nothing but a educational/instructional tool. There is legitimately no process to do any investment or stock purchases through this app whatsoever. When you contact customer service after only having the product for a couple of hours, they tell you “you agreed to the purchase, we can’t help you.” Legitimately feels misleading, unethical, and borderline fraudulent

So this helps teach you to how to trade only, you are still using your own brokerage account..  I don’t have enough confidence in this site to link my retirement account to this site.

If it allowed me to put the advertised $20 in to watch their AI play with it and possibly show me that their AI can actually make a profit, then I would invest more. 
But definitely not play with my retirement account for sure!

I’ll be eating the $40 that I really can’t afford, but that’s my own fault for not looking into it further, good luck to those that can take the time to learn it, but I just don’t have the temperament

reviews.title: Thieves and fraudsters
reviews.text:
I signed up and got tricked into 2 add ons.  Total of $120.  I immediately decided to cancel. I ask for a refund of all charges.  Was denied.  Then I was offered a 50% refund.  I said no and will report fraud charges will PayPal and my credit card company. Then I was given a partial refund. I was told they could only process the last payment. There were 3 separate charges in total. After threatening them with fraud, they then agreed to a full refund.  It took 12 emails back and forth to get my full amount refunded.  If I hadn’t fought back they would have kept my money.  Very bad business practices. I won’t ever do business with them again. Beware of this company.

In follow up I got an email from them after the review., apologizing for the hard time I was given.  But if this is standard operating procedure, it won’t change. Beware.

reviews.title: Disappointing
reviews.text:
Got this app to learn about trading and it’s a complete disappointment. But because of the content, but because it doesn’t work. Notifications never come up, so I regularly forget that I even have the app even though the notifications are switched on. When you’re going through content you have quizzes which make the narration stop, so you can listen up to the quiz and read after as the sound stops working. Some pages you can’t go back from, so if the page turns too quickly you can never find out what actually said on there. And the quizzes don’t make sense as the correct answer starts blinking immediately so you know what it is and can’t even try to guess for yourself. Completely useless!
I’m only giving it 2 stars as the content actually might be good if the rest is not glitchy and terrible…

reviews.title: Offer not honoured
reviews.text: I tried to cancel my subscription two days before it renewed. The app gave me a discounted offer to renew. Upon renewal they charged the full amount. Multiple email exchanges later, they have stated I will not be refunded and they are trying to offer extra weeks rather than the original cancellation offer. No matter how good their content, the company is dishonourable to renew under false marketing and then refusing to refund. Beware!!

reviews.title: You wanted a review: Well you got one.
reviews.text: I invested money into this app to learn and I can’t even get through one day’s lesson without being constantly asked if I want to leave a review or not.  So I’m leaving one.  My advice?  Only ask the customer if they want to leave a review once per session when you first open it.  If you absolutely have to ask multiple times per session then I feel once per hour is more than enough.  Not once every 10 seconds or so.  It’s absolutely ridiculous and greatly unnecessary.  If the app hadn’t asked me about a dozen times to leave a review maybe I could have gotten further using it before I left a review so I could give a more accurate assessment but this is what obsessively asking me if I want to leave a review will get you.  I might really love this app after I use it more but you’ll never know now.  Sadly.

reviews.title: An App iPhones Couldn’t Open
reviews.text: Literally useless. I bought this initial coarse. To say the first few lessons are for very dumb children would be to praise what it actually is. That wasn’t the issue. I was willing to hang in there to get to the hopefully useful portion. It never came. THE APP STOPPED WORKING FOR IPHONES. THEN I emailed support and GOT NO RESPONSE FOR OVER A MONTH. When we finally did connect it was back and forth with the customer service geniuses. And asking me to wait and wait and wait. It is now going on FIVE MONTHS. And I am STILL going back and forth with customer service. I asked for a refund. And they’re trying to continue to troubleshoot. Here’s the short version: An app that claims to train you by a company that can’t get their app— or their customer service— to do anything at all. BEWARE. There are a gazillion ways to learn to trade. Miss this one.

Please read other online reviews since you’ll just lose out - the fine print is ridiculous! I asked for mine and received zilch! CROOKS!

reviews.title: It’s ok I hope it’s worth the money.
reviews.text: The app is accurate and factual. However it’s pretty basic and childish. It uses cartoons and quizzes to move you through the lessons. For the price I expected a much more in depth learning experience. It’s exactly like duo lingo but for trading. And surprise. You have to spend much more than advertised price to access all the tools offered. The 20$ 4 week plan only covers the duo lingo level of learning. No AI tools or mentors. Those are up charges of 40-50$ each. And you only keep access to them if you continue the service. The app was begging me every other screen to write a review. So I did. I will see if it gets any better.

reviews.title: Bugs and contradictions
reviews.text:
I’m on my second day of training and I’ve noticed that the app is instructing me to drag and drop, yet it’s not possible.  I’ve had to tap the answers.  Not really a big deal but the answers are timed.  I’ve also noticed that some of the choices are not visible on my screen and are actually below, meaning I’ve got to move the screen upwards on my iPad.  Lastly, day 2 completely contradicted day 1.  For instance, day 1 tells me to take profits when the stock rises, but day 2 says to hold onto the stock to ride the prices.  Which one is it, according to the app???  I know what I do in reality, but this app lessons creates confusion on the basics.

I’ve been on the app for a few days and it’s very buggy.  App freezes which causes me to go back and redo the lesson. Glad they’re only a couple minutes long.

reviews.title: Misleading pricing
reviews.text:
I’m extremely disappointed with the way your app’s pricing structure is presented. After paying for the app, I was immediately prompted to pay an additional fee to unlock the very features advertised as part of the original purchase. Then, to my surprise, yet another fee was required to access even more functionality.
This layered pricing model feels deceptive. You promote a fully featured app, yet the initial payment only grants partial access. It’s misleading and leaves customers feeling misled and exploited.
This experience has eroded my trust in your business. I prefer not to continue any relationship with a company that operates in such a dishonest manner.
